# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check how many patients are in the treatment arm
print(f'Patients in treatment arm: {df[df["arm"] == "treatment"].shape[0]}')

# Check sex distribution in treatment arm
print(f'Sex distribution in treatment arm:
{df[df["arm"] == "treatment"]["sex"].value_counts()}')"}
